titles: Why Water Is the Weirdest Substance on Earth 🤔
Water Breaks a Rule Almost Every Liquid Follows
Why Ice Floats (and Why Fish Survive Winter)
short.description: Water looks boring, but it's the only common substance on Earth found naturally as a solid, liquid, and gas. Milo zooms into one bent water molecule to show how hydrogen bonds make ice expand by about 9 percent, float, and keep lakes from freezing solid.
